title: Apple launches new Mac Studios with its ‘most powerful chip ever’ — the M5 Ultra
content: Apple is announcing new models of the Mac Studio, now using the existing M5 Max and a new M5 Ultra. This reunification under one chip generation comes over a year after Apple awkwardly split the Studio between M4 Max and M3 Ultra offerings.
